zh-CN.title: 更直观的日历忙闲条
items: 忙闲条采用柔和配色，今日显示当前时间，过去时段用淡色斜纹区分
好友绑定日历后，私聊顶部展示无圆角细忙闲条；名片与私聊统一将没有忙碌记录的时段显示为空闲

en.title: Clearer calendar availability
items: Softer availability colors with a live time marker and faded hatching for elapsed hours
Friends with linked calendars show a slim square-edged strip in direct chats; profiles and chats treat gaps between returned busy periods as free
